newsitem.title: CHINA: China buys five Boeing jets for $685 mln.
newsitem.headline: China buys five Boeing jets for $685 mln.

text.p: The Civil Aviation General Administration of China (CAAC) and Boeing Co signed a $685 million deal on Tuesday for Air China to purchase five Boeing 777-200 airliners.
Under the agreement, China's aviation administration will order the five new-generation Boeing 777-200 aircraft for Chinese international carrier Air China.
Three of the planes will be delivered by the end of 1998 and the other two in 1999, officials said.

The agreement was signed by Ronald Woodard, president of Boeing Commercial Airplane Group, and Shen Yuankang, deputy director of the administration, in a ceremony in the Great Hall of the People witnessed by visiting U.S. Vice President Al Gore.
China ordered two 747 airliners from Boeing earlier this year in a $383 million deal to expand Air China's fleet.
